description: This file contains utility functions for resolving, migrating, and managing legacy configuration related to web search plugins, specifically handling API keys and plugin configuration paths within a structured configuration object.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: cloneRecord
methods.description: Creates a shallow clone of a JsonRecord or returns undefined if input is undefined.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures that a given key in a target JsonRecord is itself a JsonRecord, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: resolveLegacyXSearchConfig
methods.description: Extracts the x_search configuration object from a raw configuration object.

methods.name: resolveLegacyXSearchAuth
methods.description: Retrieves the apiKey from a legacy x_search configuration object.

methods.name: listLegacyXSearchConfigPaths
methods.description: Returns the configuration path(s) for the legacy x_search apiKey if present.

methods.name: migrateLegacyXSearchConfig
methods.description: Migrates legacy x_search configuration to a new structure, updating plugin configs and returning change logs.
